elements.label: Left side of P&L grid (accounts column and first months) re-rendering
elements.change_other: in-place re-render / sharpness and sub-pixel shift of grid content

pattern.description: The settled P&L sheet re-renders in place on its left half: account labels and the first month columns shift by a pixel or so and sharpen, while the window frame stays put. The footer status text also resolves into the copyright line.
pattern.why_premium: Little premium craft here: it is a screen-recording artefact of the app finishing its layout pass. It does show the recording was left to settle before the narration moves on, so the viewer gets a stable, readable sheet.

build_hint.gsap: Not worth recreating as an authored move. If needed: tl.fromTo(gridLeft, {x: -1, filter: 'blur(0.5px)'}, {x: 0, filter: 'blur(0px)', duration: 0.12, ease: 'power1.out'}).
build_hint.remotion: Skip in a recreation; or translateX: interpolate(frame, [f0, f0 + 4], [-1, 0], {extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}) on the grid layer.

notes: Very low changed_share (about 0.14) and camera.move none, with scale 1.0017; the motion looks like a re-render or sub-pixel reflow, not a designed animation. The cursor near 'Working Budget' has no candidate box, so it is not listed.
